title: Target Mobile App
detail: My role is Lead iOS Engineer, contributing to native iOS development and engineering practices.

title: shop & scan
summary: A mobile shopping experience for scanning items while shopping at Meijer.
detail: As iOS Lead Architect, I worked on the native iOS experience. The original project images show the shopping interface, and the archived news demonstrations below provide public product context.

images.alt: The original shop & scan interface displayed on iPhones.

videos.description: A public news report introducing Meijer’s mobile shopping checkout program.

videos.title: Milwaukee Journal Sentinel demonstration
videos.description: A public demonstration of how the shopping app works.

videos.title: News 10 Lansing launch report
videos.description: A public report on shop & scan arriving in area stores.

title: Team Assist
summary: An iOS project for Meijer store teams.
detail: My contribution was iOS development and prototyping for a practical store-team interface.

title: shop & scan status
summary: A diagnostic utility developed alongside shop & scan.
detail: I developed this Swift utility to present diagnostic information in a focused mobile interface.

title: mPizza
summary: A proof-of-concept pizza ordering app developed at Meijer.
detail: I contributed iOS interface and ordering functionality with other developers. This was a prototype, not a released consumer app.

title: Amway Refreshments
summary: An iOS application developed with designer Andy Anderson.
detail: I collaborated with Andy Anderson on a native application using Swift and Realm for local persistence.

title: The Purpose Driven Life
summary: A HarperCollins app for reading Rick Warren’s book one day at a time.
detail: The original screens show daily readings, videos, bookmarks, and notes. I worked on iOS development during my time at HarperCollins.

images.alt: Two iPhones showing The Purpose Driven Life: the Day 22 screen with Read Now, Bookmarks, and My Notes, and the Day 22 reading with a Rick Warren video above highlighted text

title: Common Prayer
summary: A daily prayer app developed for HarperCollins Publishers.
detail: Morning, midday, and evening prayers sit alongside the day’s reading and a text-size control in the original app screens.

images.alt: Two iPhones showing Common Prayer: the October 25 overview with morning, midday, and evening prayers, and that day's prayer text with a text-size slider

title: StudyGateway
summary: A video Bible-study app for browsing series and following session guides.
detail: The archived screens show series discovery, author information, a session list, study-guide content, and video playback.

images.alt: StudyGateway's home screen on an iPhone, with rows of study series under New Releases, Fitness, and Bestsellers

Rick Warren's author page, with his biography and his series

title: Seth Godin’s Blog
summary: An iPhone and iPad app for reading Seth Godin’s blog.
detail: Built with designer Andy Anderson, the app presented a post list and reading view across iPhone and iPad.

images.alt: Two iPhones showing the Seth Godin app: a list of recent posts and a post open for reading
The Seth Godin app on an iPad, with the post list beside an open post, and on an iPhone showing the post list

title: FastCast
summary: An earlier personal weather app, now being reimagined as Klimate.
detail: The original app combined current conditions, forecasts, and radar. The archived iPad demonstration is from 2014; Klimate represents the current work.

images.alt: FastCast showing current conditions for Grandville, MI, forecasts for today, tonight, and Monday, and a radar map

videos.description: An archived demonstration of the earlier weather app on iPad.
